# Installed only by the check-docs job of test.yml and the reference job of
# release.yml, to run api_reference.py; neither is a dependency of xcl-lang.
#
# griffe reads the package statically, so the doc comment check needs no
# engine and can see the doc comment following a constant, which runtime
# introspection cannot.
griffe==2.4.1
# docutils turns the package's reStructuredText doc comments into the HTML
# the reference shows, and fails the check on bad markup.
docutils==0.23
